propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) paginate projects using an opaque nextPageToken cursor but have no test exercising more than a single page.
The existing test coverage in test_acli_cross_mixin_binding.py feeds only single-page payloads with isLast: True, leaving the cursor loop untested.

A regression net with mutation-verified oracles was added in test_acli_graph_pagination_heldout.py to assert cursor advance, both termination conditions (isLast and exhausted cursor), and prevention of silent truncation across 3+ pages.

A real defect was discovered: if a server repeats its nextPageToken with isLast falsy, the readers spin forever because neither break condition fires, and the fail-open exception handler swallows the error, yielding a silently partial map.

An AST structural guard was added to prevent unpaginated whole-project readers from being added silently, scanning adapters/jira/*.py for functions POSTing /rest/api/3/search/jql without both a loop and nextPageToken reference.
